key_notes: Key 1 (t=7.5s): Initial archival pose of bowtie; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=8.62s): Mid-sequence articulation of bowtie; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=9.86s): Peak dynamic extension of bowtie over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=11.1s): Follow-through and settle of bowtie with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of bowtie (7.5s..11.1s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
